experience.description: Optimized large multimodal models (LMMs) to understand 3D scenes and guide human behavior in AR; Developed algorithms that use spatial cues to detect, localize and track objects in the real world; Contributed to open-source python projects, including librosa, spatialscaper, mirdata, and micarraylib

Designed signal processing algorithms for the embedded audio system of the Model S and Model X; Wrote testing pipelines to identify signal distortion in A2DP and PCM streaming; Designed signal processing layouts with the AudioWeaver software for dedicated audio hardware

Optimized the transformer neural architecture to carry out automatic speech recognition (ASR); Collected human data with novel sensors designed for natural voice interaction with Siri; Designed deep neural network architectures that integrate speech with multimodal signals
Developed neural networks and curated datasets for biometric authentication of users with audio headsets; Optimized the size of the neural network to be small enough to run in an embedded system
